summary: Sprint 'Frontend Usability & Workflow Completion' verified. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass (global search RBAC envelope, portal-test-patient seeder idempotency + tags/mrn/consent flags, portal-status, portal-invite/reset/disable/enable, invoice PDF %PDF magic + INV- filename, invoice email stub, lab attach/detach, campaign HTML with merge vars + SMS plain). Frontend: admin login (MFA via pyotp) succeeds; sidebar Search-anything trigger + Ctrl+K palette open and return Users bucket (Site Administrator hit shown). Per-page searches confirmed on Treatments, Inventory, Users, POS ('Search treatments…'), Lab Review. Transactions page has per-row PDF/Print/Email buttons wired via data-testid txn-download-*, txn-print-*, txn-email-*. Campaign New dialog: TipTap ProseMirror rich editor with full toolbar (Bold, Italic, Underline, H1, H2, lists, link, image, table, Variables dropdown, undo/redo) + 'Show preview' toggle. Provider Patient Chart route /portal/provider/patients/{cid} renders PortalAccessPanel with 'Portal access', 'Copy portal login URL', and 'TEST PATIENT' badge. Two minor radix DialogContent aria warnings observed on the campaign dialog (a11y polish only, non-blocking).

minor.issue: Response strips `tags` field because ClientOut Pydantic model doesn't declare it. Frontend can rely on /portal-status.is_test_patient instead, but any component that reads tags off the client resource will miss the portal_test_patient flag.

issues: Radix DialogContent emits console warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. A11y-only, non-blocking, but should be resolved with VisuallyHidden DialogTitle.

action_items: Optional: add `tags: Optional[List[str]] = None` to `ClientIn`/`ClientOut` in /app/backend/models.py so the portal_test_patient flag is visible on GET /api/clients/{id} (frontend currently doesn't seem to need it — /portal-status.is_test_patient covers it).
Optional: wrap the New-campaign DialogContent's title with `<DialogTitle>` (or VisuallyHidden version) to silence Radix a11y console warnings.
No blocking action items — the sprint scope is functionally complete.
critical_code_review_comments: portal_ops.py: search endpoint escapes user input via re.escape before feeding to $regex — correctly prevents ReDoS/injection. Response envelope shape matches spec {query, results:{...}} with empty-bucket pruning.
portal_ops.py: _get_or_create_portal_user is idempotent by email, links the client on existing-user path, and reactivates disabled users on invite — good.
portal_ops.py: /portal-invite returns invite_url only when HIPAA_MODE=false; audit log records email_hash rather than email — HIPAA-safe.

ops.py _render_invoice_pdf: server-side PDF is single-canvas ReportLab, includes practice branding, from/to, itemized lines, totals, payment status, footer. Uses env-driven practice info with sensible defaults. `showPage` is called if the item list overflows past 2.2 inches — pagination minimal but present.
ops.py _send_email_with_attachment: falls back to integration_log stub when email_status()!=live, uses asyncio.to_thread for the blocking SendGrid call, and never raises out — good defensive posture.
lab_review.py: attach/detach both enforce delegation for admin/medical_assistant and validate cross-client file mismatch on attach — correct.
campaigns.py: _render_html + _render_plain (HTML-aware) + _fill_variables handle both TipTap output and SMS textarea uniformly. Merge fields substitute per-recipient.
MINOR: `_hash_email` is defined twice (portal_ops.py returns hex64, ops.py returns hex16). Not a bug, but the two shadow definitions could drift; consider extracting a shared audit helper.
MINOR: ClientOut model in models.py does not include `tags` — the seeded portal_test_patient tag is invisible to any frontend reading /api/clients/{id}. See minor backend_issues above.
MINOR: Campaign New dialog triggers 2 Radix a11y console warnings (DialogTitle/aria-describedby).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all sprint UI targets verified; only cosmetic a11y warnings)
